ordering: Each giver's three duties advance strictly in listed order; next duty activates on subsequent actionable event (no one event completes multiple duties)
world_rule: Progress does not itself transfer chips; completion after 3 releases service and changes rank to unbound Fallen until next social promotion

duties.text: Prove your nerve: make a legal preflop raise and remain through the next betting decision.
duties.failure: no punitive chip confiscation; remains active until completed

duties.text: Let the table see you: participate in one contested showdown.
Bring the house honor: finish a contract table in its top two living stacks.
duties.reward: service_progress +1; Vesper Favor +1; all 3 duties release service pact

duties.text: Witness the truth: observe one contested showdown, whether or not you remain in the hand.
Record one Veil or Mirror spell cast legally while you remain at the table.
Complete a showdown in which at least one opponent reveals a poker hand.
duties.reward: service_progress +1; Oracle Favor +1; all 3 duties release service pact

duties.text: Show restraint: take a legal check action in a hand.
Know when to yield: fold once to a bet or raise of at least the current big blind.
Survive honestly: finish a full contract table with one or more Lifechips.
duties.reward: service_progress +1; Corvin Favor +1; all 3 duties release service pact
